name: human_02_two_probes_out_freshwater
story: Planted 120 L community tank, setpoint 27, no chiller. Owner rearranges rocks, lifts the probe bundle (probes 0 and 2 stick together) out of the water and leaves it on the cabinet for 7 h in the evening; probe 1 stays in the water.

events.note: Probe bundle lifted out together, left on the cabinet (~20 C)
Second probe of the same bundle

expect: Two of three probes drop toward room temp (~20 C) while probe 1 stays at ~27 C: massive disagreement -> sensorFault -> fail-safe, heater powered and ruled ONLY by its internal thermostat (25.5 C).
A lone remaining valid probe must NOT be trusted to regulate (no corroboration). BUG if firmware regulates on probe 1 alone, or on the median/mean of the three.
Tank settles around 25-26 C (below the 27 C setpoint, still in fish ideal band 24-28) for ~7 h, no stress. Probe alarm after 30 s debounce; no undertemp alarm (silent in fail-safe).
BUG if the heater is switched off (would be the case if firmware trusted the cold probes as 'too hot' misreads or trusts a rising/falling reading) or the two cold probes cause an undertemp alarm.
After 24 h the probes return: both re-seeded after lockout, fail-safe exits, normal regulation back to 27 C setpoint, no overshoot above 28 C.
